segments.title: 第94章 三人行
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 94: A Threesome

After Ying Chanxi put on a show of getting something from her house, the two went downstairs together and hailed a taxi back to Bihai Lanting.

In the car, Li Luo asked curiously, "What did you get?"

"Nothing," Ying Chanxi said, turning her head away.

In reality, she hadn't gotten anything... she was just pretending.

Her original plan was to go home first, then find Li Luo at his place and pretend she had just come back to get something, asking him if he was returning to Bihai Lanting that night.

Unexpectedly, she had been caught the moment she got back.

Li Luo didn't think much of it. Seeing that Ying Chanxi didn't want to say, he didn't press the matter.

The taxi moved through the night.

As they were about to reach their destination, Li Luo felt his phone vibrate a few times.

He took it out and saw that someone was looking for him on QQ.

Opening QQ, Li Luo looked on in confusion, wondering who it was.

He had thought it might be his editor, another author, or maybe a classmate.

But upon closer inspection, he realized it was his nephew, Li Xiang, who had just left.

That was truly a rare occurrence.

Although their two families were very close, Li Luo and Li Xiang couldn't exactly be called intimate.

Especially after Li Xiang started middle school and began boarding, they hardly ever saw each other except during New Year's and other holidays.

This was the first time Li Xiang had ever messaged Li Luo privately on QQ.

This piqued Li Luo's curiosity. He opened the chat window to see what he had said.

But the next second, Li Luo's expression darkened.

Li Xiang: [Screenshot] [Screenshot] [Screenshot]

Li Xiang: I'm a full subscriber, a legitimate reader on Qidian. I've been reading this book of yours recently.

Li Xiang: I think it's really well-written. Don't listen to my grandpa's bullshit. They're old-fashioned; it's normal for them not to understand web novels.

Li Xiang: You have to keep going. I usually enjoy reading entertainment-circle novels, and among the recent ones, yours is the best written.

Li Luo: "..."

You little brat... you just don't want the book you're reading to get dropped out of nowhere, right?

You've really gone out of your way.

You didn't say a single word at the dinner table, but you've got plenty to say in private.

You could have at least said a few words for me at dinner!

But on second thought, if he had found out at the dinner table that his own dear nephew was also reading his novel, Li Luo would have probably wanted to find a block of tofu to smash his head into and die.

Sigh... it's so hard to write a book these days. Trying to write a book that your family can also read is even harder.

At this point, Li Luo had given up struggling.

Li Luo: I won't drop it. I just finished talking to my parents, and I'll keep writing.

Li Xiang: That's great! You write well, and I'll promote it for you at school.

Li Luo: "???"

Li Luo: There's absolutely no need for that! Just read it yourself.

Li Xiang: It's fine, it's just a small effort. No need to be polite with me.

Was that his way of being polite?!

Why was this nephew so disobedient?

Li Xiang: By the way, can you write more about Jiang Mingyue?

Li Xiang: You spent so long building it up before, saying the protagonist might shoot a movie and promised Jiang Mingyue he'd help bring her from TV dramas into the film industry.

Li Xiang: But there's still no sign of it. After the plot related to the last TV drama, how long has it been since Jiang Mingyue appeared?

Li Xiang: You only trotted her out during the Shuraba. At least give us more daily interactions between her and the protagonist!

Li Luo: "..."

This was ridiculous.

It was one thing to be pestered by Yan Zhusheng to write more about Mo Qinghan.

But what the hell was this, being pestered by his own nephew to write more about Jiang Mingyue?

Why was everyone a single-character stan?

Isn't having them all better?

They have no vision at all.

Li Luo: I think you're talking a little too much. Writing a book follows an outline, and I will only proceed according to the planned outline.

Li Luo said this to brush him off.

But the next second, Li Xiang replied.

Li Xiang: Uncle! I'm begging you! More Jiang Mingyue!

Seeing that form of address, Li Luo fell silent for a moment.

He never thought the title he hadn't heard Li Xiang say in so many years would be uttered so easily.

He had no backbone at all!

Li Luo: Alright, alright, I'll do my best.

After fending off Li Xiang, Li Luo and Ying Chanxi arrived at the entrance of the Bihai Lanting residential complex.

"I gave my parents my word. I have to get into the top 100 on the midterms," Li Luo said to Ying Chanxi beside him as they walked. "From now on, let's have an evening self-study session at home every night after we get back. I'll ask you for help with anything I don't understand."

Hearing this, Ying Chanxi's eyes crinkled in delight. She nodded and said, "Okay, should we start today?"

"Sure." Li Luo glanced at the time. "Let's study until nine tonight."

"No problem."

The two returned to 1502 and took out their keys to open the door.

When the door opened, they found the lights in the apartment were on.

"Huh?" Xu Youyu, who was lying on the sofa and sucking on a Xiaobuding ice pop, propped up her upper body in surprise, craning her neck to look at the doorway. "You're back? I thought you two went home to sleep."

"Why are you back?" Li Luo asked, looking puzzled. "Didn't you go home?"

"I was kicked out." Xu Youyu lifted her legs and flailed them a couple of times before they slapped back onto the sofa. She chuckled. "The first day, I was treated like a treasure. The second day, they asked me why I always sleep in. The third day, I had to wake up early. Is this any way for a person to spend a holiday?"

"It's still more comfortable here." Xu Youyu hopped off the sofa with relish, then walked into the kitchen and took out two Xiaobuding ice pops from the fridge. "Here, I just bought these today. Want one?"

Li Luo took one.

Ying Chanxi, however, shook her head. "I can't eat that for the next few days."

"Oh, okay." Xu Youyu put the other one back in the fridge.

By now, Ying Chanxi had already walked back to her bedroom to get her schoolbag.

There was just a slight hint of disappointment in her eyes.

But she quickly cheered up, walked out of her bedroom with her schoolbag, and said to Xu Youyu on the sofa, "Xuejie, Li Luo and I are going to review our lessons. Do you want to join us?"

"No way... you guys are so serious?" Xu Youyu finished her Xiaobuding, tossing the wooden stick, now glistening and moist from her mouth, into the trash can. "I guess I'll join you for a little while."

With that, she went to her bedroom and brought out a few books and exercise manuals.

Soon, the three of them were sitting in a row at the long desk in the living room.

Since the main purpose was to tutor Li Luo, he sat in the middle this time, with Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu on either side of him.

"The top student from Grade 11 and Grade 12, tutoring you together." Xu Youyu couldn't help but sigh after sitting down. "If you still can't get into the top 100 with this, then you're truly a hopeless case."

If it were anyone else, Li Luo might have been prepared for a future face-slapping moment.

But facing academic gods at the pinnacle like Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu, Li Luo didn't dare act recklessly.

It was best to just study obediently. Besides, he had no intention of vying for the top spot in the grade.

As long as he could get into the top 100 and smoothly get into Qianjiang University in the college entrance exam, he didn't need to think too much about other things.

Exams were just a means to an end; achieving the goal behind them was what mattered.

"I'll find a set of mock papers for you tomorrow," Ying Chanxi said after some thought. "Based on the high school material we've already learned, I'll make a midterm exam for you in advance to see how well you've mastered it."

Li Luo naturally had no objections and shamelessly said, "Then why don't you two do it with me? I'll see if I can surpass you."

"A beautiful thought," Xu Youyu said with a grin. "But reality can be cruel."

Ying Chanxi didn't say much, just chuckled, "Hehe."

(End of Chapter)
